messages:
Maya Chen: hey team, opened a small docs PR for the migration guide (GH #3421). looking for one reviewer + a quick sanity check on tone
Samir Patel: assigned myself — will skim this afternoon. quick Q: are we standardizing on ‘Redwood API’ vs ‘redwood api’ in this doc?
Maya Chen: good catch — style guide says `Redwood API` (capitalized product names). also prefer ‘model variant’ not ‘model version’ per glossary
Lee Wong: running the docs preview now. flagged a linkcheck failure for a relative link in the snippets section
Docs CI Bot: preview build started for PR #3421 — docs-preview.redwood.dev/preview/3421 :white_check_mark:
Ana Rivera: about voice: keep examples action-oriented and avoid marketing language. this line: "best-in-class inference" should be replaced with a concrete tradeoff (latency/cost)
Maya Chen: replaced that sentence with: "target latency under 150ms at 95th percentile for the small-embedding workload." let me know if wording is too prescriptive
Samir Patel: looks good. one nit: code samples use double quotes in some places and single quotes elsewhere. prefer double quotes for JSON snippets to match SDK examples
Maya Chen: ack — will normalize to double quotes
Chris B.: also check the SDK snippet — we recently changed the client constructor name. current snippet shows `new RedwoodClient()` but the code should be `new InferenceClient()`
Maya Chen: updated snippet. here's the code block I changed:

```
const client = new InferenceClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-small-v1', prompt: '...' });
```

Lee Wong: preview is green after linkfix and snippet update. left one inline comment about adding a short migration note for users who relied on the old constructor
Maya Chen: added a short section "Migration: constructor rename" — simple 3-line diff example
Ana Rivera: one more tone thing: drop the sentence "this is trivial to update" — can read as dismissive. suggest "requires updating the constructor name and verifying integration tests." 
Maya Chen: changed to your suggestion
Samir Patel: ready to approve once CI passes. will leave an approval comment in GH in ~30m :thumbsup:
Docs CI Bot: linkcheck passed, preview build complete — no broken links detected :rocket:
Maya Chen: thanks all! will merge during next docs merge window (tomorrow 10:00 PT) unless anyone objects
Lee Wong: no objections from me
Ana Rivera: fine by me
Samir Patel: approved on GH
Maya Chen: merging after window — will backport to /stable branch post-merge
